name: Darkvision
description: The creature's eyes are completely adapted to pitch blackness, ignoring all illumination penalties.

name: Natural Camouflage
description: The creature blends into its native environment perfectly.

name: Telepathic
description: Can communicate mentally with any sentient creature within line of sight.

name: Prehensile Appendage
description: An extra arm or tail that allows the character to ignore 1 point of multi-action penalties.

name: Amorphous Form
description: The creature has no rigid skeletal structure. Immune to crushing damage and can squeeze through keyholes.

name: Frightening Visage
description: The entity is naturally terrifying to behold.

name: Iron Stomach
description: Gains a +4 bonus to resist ingested poisons and diseases.

name: Magical Affinity
description: Innate connection to the arcane weaves.

name: Beast Speaker
description: Can comprehend and communicate with natural beasts.

name: Crystalline Skin
description: Reflective skin that grants +4 Armor specifically against energy-based attacks.

name: Hive Mind Link
description: Tied to a collective consciousness. Attackers gain no Gang Up bonuses against this character.

name: Sunlight Sensitivity
description: Direct sunlight causes extreme discomfort, resulting in a -1 to all Trait rolls.

name: Volatile Blood
description: The creature's blood is acidic or searing hot. Melee attackers take 1d4 damage when dealing a Wound.

name: Hover
description: The creature naturally floats a few feet off the ground, ignoring difficult terrain.

name: Goo-like Weakness
description: Extremely vulnerable to area-of-effect elemental attacks, taking +4 damage.

name: Soul Siphon
description: Killing a sentient foe in melee combat restores one level of Fatigue.

name: Phasing
description: Can walk through up to one foot of solid non-magical material at the cost of 1 Fatigue.

name: Symbiotic Surge
description: Can spend a Benny to temporarily upgrade Strength by one die type for the scene.

name: Elemental Resistance
description: Takes half damage from a chosen elemental source.

name: Ancestral Memory
description: Can perfectly recall ancient lore, granting +2 to Knowledge/Academics rolls.
